Clear the lot. Fill the buses.

Tiny Depot is a colour-matching bus puzzle for iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and Mac. Tap a bus, park it in a bay, and watch the riders hop aboard.

See how it plays Coming soon

From gridlock to all aboard

  1. Tap a bus

    It drives the way its roof arrow points. If another bus is in the way, it bumps and rolls back.

  2. Park it in a bay

    With a clear path, the bus takes the first free bay. Bays are limited, so your order matters.

  3. Fill the seats

    Riders of the same colour hop aboard. A full bus leaves and frees its bay for the next one.

Fifteen places to untangle

Each one has its own lot, kerb and bus stop, from quiet streets to neon nights, and from Istanbul to London, Paris, Tokyo, New York, Venice, Marrakech and the Moon.

Eleven buses, and a few tricks

New buses roll in as you play. Bigger ones take bigger crowds, and some have tricks up their roof.

  • Classic

    3 seats, from level 1

  • Round Shuttle

    4 seats, from level 5

  • Double Decker

    5 seats, from level 12

  • Coach

    6 seats, from level 24

  • Twin Bus

    5 seats, from level 104

  • Sightseer

    7 seats, from level 176

  • Hopper

    From level 256

    Jumps over one bus in its way.

  • Mega Bus

    9 seats, from level 304

    Three spaces long.

  • Chameleon

    4 seats, from level 352

    Takes the colour of the first rider in line.

  • Carnival Bus

    6 seats, from level 400

    Calls every rider of its colour from the line.

  • Mystery Bus

    From level 448

    Hides its colour until its way out is clear.

Play your way

Race the clock or take it easy, in the language you like, and share your play stats only if you want to.

Collect trophies, climb the ranking

Finish every level in a place to win its road trophy, fifteen in all. Every hundred levels adds a cup, five in all. Each trophy is also a Game Center achievement.

See where you stand

Your highest level counts on a worldwide Game Center leaderboard. Open Ranking from the trophy shelf to see the top 10 and your own place.

Game Center is optional. Sign in to join the ranking, or play on without it and nothing is sent.

500 levels down one long road

Every level is a stop on the road through all fifteen places. The lots get fuller as you go, and later levels close a bay. Each one is tested to make sure it can be solved.

  • No accounts or ads
  • Plays offline
  • 6 languages
